## Our Vision in Action

Trivitron delivers integrated, adaptable technology that strengthens healthcare from remote
communities to advanced hospitals — giving every clinician the tools for faster, more confident
decisions worldwide.

### Public Health & Screening

Early Detection at Population Scale. Scalable screening to detect disease early and protect
communities. From newborn screening to outbreak diagnostics, we empower national programs with
portable, cost-effective systems saving lives in resource-limited settings.

### Modern Laboratory Solutions

Precision Diagnostics, Accelerated Workflows. High-throughput diagnostic systems built for accuracy,
speed, and seamless automation. From routine to specialized tests, our advanced IVD platforms and
complete range of healthcare solutions deliver fast, reliable results that drive better clinical
decisions - globally.

### Hospitals and Clinics

Seamless technology for frontline care. Integrated medical technology solutions for confident,
real-time care. From patient monitors and ventilators to point-of-care devices, our modular systems
integrate effortlessly across rural clinics and tertiary hospitals.

### AI Solutions

AI That Works in the Real World. Practical AI for faster, more accurate diagnostics and smarter
workflows. From radiology image enhancement to predictive lab analytics, our clinically validated
tools integrate seamlessly into daily practice.

# Worldwide supplier of affordable medical disposables

Ace Medical Devices has been a trusted supplier of affordable medical disposables for over 15 years.
We specialize in [urology][36], [gastro endoscopy][37] and [surgical products][38] and we deliver
our supplies directly to hospitals and through our [worldwide network of partners][39].

### A proven reputation thanks to strict quality control

Over the past decade, ACE Medical Devices has built a stellar reputation by focusing on our
principle of quality first. When it comes to medical supplies, quality control is our first, second
and third priority. We aim to be competitively priced based on innovation, efficiency and scale.
This allowed us to build a strong network of distributing partners worldwide, who prove every day
that cost-effectiveness and proven quality can go hand in hand.

### Trust is our business model

We worked hard to establish our reputation as a reliable supplier of quality medical products, from
basic disposables to more advanced medical products. We are proud to be your long-term partner and
to put India on the map of high-quality medical device manufacturing.

# Beacon Diagnostics - IVD Manufacturer & Exporter from India

At Beacon Diagnostics Pvt. Ltd., our journey began in 1990 with a clear mission — to deliver
reliable and innovative diagnostic solutions that elevate healthcare standards in India and across
the globe. Headquartered in Navsari, Gujarat, Beacon Diagnostics has grown into one of the most
trusted names in the industry, known for our quality, commitment, and technological excellence. For
over 33 years, we’ve been at the forefront of the IVD Manufacturer & Exporter in India, offering a
wide spectrum of reagents and instruments tailored for accurate medical testing. As a certified
company with ISO 9001:2015, ISO 13485:2016, and ZED Gold credentials, we ensure every product meets
international standards of performance and Regulatory compliances.
Our product line includes advanced systems like Top [biochemistry analyzers][19], [ Hematology
Analyzers][20], [ electrolyte analyzers][21], [ urine analyzers][22], which are designed to support
clinical labs with efficiency and precision, and there by supporting better patient outcomes for
healthier society. As a forward-thinking IVD manufacturer in India, Beacon’s reach spans across 90+
countries, powered by strong global collaborations. Back home, our presence is equally strong—with
135+ field experts, 100+ service engineers, and a distribution network of 400+ partners catering to
private, public, and semi-government healthcare sectors. At the core of Beacon India is a team
driven by innovation and integrity. From our expertise in [ Beacon Reagents][23] to our reputation
as a dependable IVD Products manufacturer, we remain committed to empowering laboratories with tools
that are accurate, affordable, and accessible. Together, as the Beacon company, we continue to
illuminate the path forward in diagnostics—building trust, advancing technology, and improving
lives.

our partners, clients, and stakeholders, and to the dedication of our entire team who work

## About Us

# India’s Leading Medical Equipments Manufacturers & Exporters

GST Corporation Limited (**GSTC**) is one of India’s leading Medical Equipments Manufacturers &
Exporters, with more than six decades of dedication in providing trusted & reliable medical
solutions worldwide since 1959. Based in New Delhi, we are into surgical equipments, rehabilitation
aids, orthopedic implants, and** FDA-approved medical disposables **with the highest international
standard.

 

## **Global Reach. Certified Quality.**

With the support of FDA, CE, EAR,  ISO 9001:2015, and ISO 13485:2016 certifications,GSTC has
established a good reputation for high quality, best manufacturing, and conformance to regulations.
Hospitals, clinics, non-governmental organizations, and tender authorities in over 65 nations across
the globe, including the USA, Canada, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Southeast Asia, and Latin
America, accept our products in the majority of cases. We are among the leading exporters of medical
devices from India.

 

## **Trusted by Governments, NGOs & Global Health Missions**

# WORLD-CLASS MANUFACTURERS OF CUTTING-EDGE MEDICAL DEVICES

[Hindustan Syringes and Medical Devices][147], commonly referred to as HMD, is a manufacturer and
distributor of high-quality medical devices  for use in hospitals and healthcare facilities
worldwide. Their product family includes [Single Use Syringes][148], [I.V Cannulas][149], [Blood
Collection Tubes][150] & others
[More Info][151]
[https://hmdhealthcare.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/68-years.jpeg][https://hmdhealthcare.com/wp-co
ntent/uploads/2025/08/68-years.jpeg]

## Top Manufacturer of Medical Instruments Devices in India

Established in 1957, Hindustan Syringes & Medical Devices Ltd. (HMD) is among India’s most promising
medical equipment manufacturers Founded by (Late) Mr. Narindra Nath, HMD Ltd. was created with the
motive of manufacturing and innovating high-quality, low-cost medical instruments for hospitals and

### Who We Are

Lattice MedTech, backed by **[OrbiMed][18]** (a $17Bn global healthcare fund), is building India’s
next-generation MedTech platform. Our mission is to unify and modernize the fragmented medical
device distribution landscape, enabling global brands and Indian manufacturers to scale efficiently.

[ Read More][19]

## Our Services

[ ]

### [Distribution of Medical Devices ][20]

We offer a wide range of medical devices across critical specialties, including cardiology,
orthopedics, general surgery, critical care, and IVD. As a prominent cardiology distributor, we
enhance our offerings. With our pan-India fulfillment ability through our distribution partners,
including our role as a surgical distributor in India and a trusted Medtech distributor in India, we
can enable unparalleled reach of medical devices for our clients.

[ Read More][21]
[ ]

### [ Strategic Manufacturing][22]

With our deep capabilities in the MedTech manufacturing ecosystem in India, we aspire to be the
first choice as a Medtech distributor in India and strategic manufacturing partner for global
companies. Our goal is to support their mission as a leading cardiology distributor and surgical
distributor in India, providing high-quality, cost-effective solutions for patients across the world

[ Read More][23]
[ ]

### [Full Service Distribution Partnerships][24]

We leverage best-in-class teams and cutting-edge technology as a leading Medtech distributor in
India to provide fast, reliable, compliant, and cost-effective market expansion services. Our
expertise as a cardiology distributor and surgical distributor in India ensures that global medical
device companies can successfully enter and thrive in the Indian market

[ Read More][25]

## Our Purpose
* Transforming India’s fragmented MedTech distribution into a unified, specialty-driven platform.
* Trusted partner for global brands and Indian manufacturers.
* Enabling faster, compliant, and profitable access to India’s $50B+ healthcare market.
* Expertise in sales, regulatory affairs, and logistics with a pan-India distribution network.
* Driving equitable access to advanced healthcare across hospitals, clinics, and tier-2/3 cities.

##### About Lotus

## A medical device range at par with the best in the world

Lotus, a brand of TI Medical, with a 17-year legacy, is a leading name in the Medical Device
Industry, operating from a state-of-the-art 60,000 square feet facility in Dehradun, India,
featuring Class 10,000 Clean Rooms and a specialized 100% EtO Sterilizer. We take immense pride in
delivering top-notch Sterile Medical Devices with an unwavering commitment to quality. Our product
range includes Absorbable & Non-Absorbable Sutures, Meshes, Haemostats, Endo & Energy Devices,
catering to various medical specialties across 25,000+ hospitals in 60+ countries.

Lotus has earned recognition in the industry, winning the Frost & Sullivan Best Consumables Company
of the Year in 2013 and being named the Economic Times Best Healthcare Brand in 2023, 2024 & 2025.
We are dedicated to innovation, excellence, and a global vision that propels us forward in the
healthcare industry. We embrace the dynamism of surgical innovation. Join us to discover the
intricate world of medical devices, where precision, innovation, and care come together to redefine
surgical excellence. Welcome to the future of medical technology at Lotus.

## Our Range of Products

Complete range of Absorbable & Non-Absorbable, Braided & Monofilament sutures catering to every
specialty, including Cardio-Vascular and Plastic surgery

### Here Is A Little ** About Us**

Medorah Meditek Pvt Ltd is an ISO 13485 Certified Indian medical device manufacturing company
headquartered in Delhi. We have been operating in India since 2016, and our primary focus is to
supply the highest quality Gastroenterology, Pulmonology, and Interventional Radiology equipment and
accessories.

We aim to bring significant technological advancements to the medical device industry and improve
global healthcare standards.
Keeping the requirements of both regulatory authorities and our customers in mind, we are leading
the industry in the design, development, manufacturing, and sales of innovative medical devices
critical to gastroenterology, pulmonology, and interventional radiology.

Our purpose is to make healthcare affordable and accessible for everyone. Our Mission guides and
reminds us that we are helping India by providing quality healthcare to millions of people who
otherwise would not be able to afford it.

[Learn More][78]

##### Our Quality Policy

At Medorah Meditek Pvt. Ltd., our Quality Policy summarises the essential elements of our commitment
to excellence and includes:

• Fostering a quality mind-set to develop, manufacture and provide products with zero defects and
optimum performance that are trusted and preferred by Healthcare Professionals and deliver on our
commitment to improve the lives of the ailing population,
• Complying with relevant laws and regulations as well as internal requirements,
• Continual improvement of the Quality Management System to guarantee product safety, avoid failures
and eliminate defects by evaluating quality objectives and results, and
• Promoting the Quality Management System and ensuring implementation amongst all employees and
third parties through standards, education, training, coaching, supervision and effective
communication.

### Why **Medorah Meditek ?**

Medorah Meditek helps you transform your patients' lives with remarkable innovations and
technologies. Our equipment improves healthcare standards by providing more straightforward and
efficient solutions for your requirements.
* We thoroughly research the market to understand your current needs and requirements.
* We are an ethically run business that works to make healthcare accessible and affordable
  worldwide.
* Under the "Make in India" platform, we aim to significantly reduce import dependency in the Indian
  scenario, thereby reducing healthcare costs and promoting local innovation.
* By collaborating with stakeholders to solve their complex problems, we design and develop

  effective solutions possible.

## Our Vision in Action

Trivitron delivers integrated, adaptable technology that strengthens healthcare from remote
communities to advanced hospitals — giving every clinician the tools for faster, more confident
decisions worldwide.

### Public Health & Screening

Early Detection at Population Scale. Scalable screening to detect disease early and protect
communities. From newborn screening to outbreak diagnostics, we empower national programs with
portable, cost-effective systems saving lives in resource-limited settings.

### Modern Laboratory Solutions

Precision Diagnostics, Accelerated Workflows. High-throughput diagnostic systems built for accuracy,
speed, and seamless automation. From routine to specialized tests, our advanced IVD platforms and
complete range of healthcare solutions deliver fast, reliable results that drive better clinical
decisions - globally.

### Hospitals and Clinics

Seamless technology for frontline care. Integrated medical technology solutions for confident,
real-time care. From patient monitors and ventilators to point-of-care devices, our modular systems
integrate effortlessly across rural clinics and tertiary hospitals.

### AI Solutions

AI That Works in the Real World. Practical AI for faster, more accurate diagnostics and smarter
workflows. From radiology image enhancement to predictive lab analytics, our clinically validated
tools integrate seamlessly into daily practice.

itself in the International arena.

With the Indian economy blazing away on a high growth path, urbanisation and increase in disposable
incomes is influencing the growth of the healthcare sector in India.

Better patient awareness with accent on objective and informed diagnosis is fuelling the growth of
the IVD industry. The IVD industry in India is growing rapidly to keep pace with the demands made on
it by the healthcare professionals both nationally and internationally.

The IVD market in India is valued at approximately USD 150 million per annum for reagent kits and
laboratory equipments and is growing at 20% per annum on a compounded basis.

The Indian IVD manufacturers are playing a leading role in spearheading this growth, and are
increasingly using their expertise to also conquer international markets.

#### Articulating Laparoscopic Instrument

ArtiSential's end-effectors simulate the surgeon's wrist movements and allow angled approach to
target surgical sites requiring precision access.

[Learn More

### ADVALVE

#### Biological Heart Valve Prosthesis

Valve leaflets are made of bovine pericardium. Biological material is preserved, sterilized and
cross-linked with ethylene glycol diglycidyl ether. Biological material fixed under technique used
in Advalve demonstrates resilience to calcium uptake and durability with regard to long-term
clinical performance. It features a compound stent combining polypropylene and superelastic
shape-memory alloy, delivering structural stability and adaptive fit within the native anatomy.

[Learn More
][4]

Naturally Versatile - Constructed using Advanced Digital Fabrication techniques and high-quality
bovine xenopericardial patches, the conduit features a stentless tri-leaflet valve that closely
replicates native pulmonary valve function.

[Learn More
][5]

Designed for use across diverse coronary anatomies, the ADVA ACE Everolimus-Eluting Coronary Stent
System features an optimized stent structure with controlled everolimus release for reliable
deployment characteristics.

[Learn More
][6]

Advancing the PORT for greater control. The new Optical Trocar that brings unmatched clarity and
guided control to every procedure. Polycarbonate tip and reduced angle of penetration which splits
the tissue and provides minimal tissue damage. This reduces the chance of port site herniation.

Asia Actual provides medical device registration, authorized representative services, and
independent license holding across Asia Pacific. We serve as the local regulatory representative in
16 APAC markets, supporting regulatory market access for medical device and IVD manufacturers.

channel management, IP protection, and regulatory support.

To provide a stable, reliable local platform so that our clients can grow their businesses in
challenging Asian markets. We strive to provide the fastest market access and customs clearance for
important medical device innovations.

industry

Penumbra

Shay Levav

IceCure Medical Ltd.

to get first-hand information without having to go multiple tiers of relationships. This approach

our products to market on time.”

# Beacon Diagnostics - IVD Manufacturer & Exporter from India

At Beacon Diagnostics Pvt. Ltd., our journey began in 1990 with a clear mission — to deliver
reliable and innovative diagnostic solutions that elevate healthcare standards in India and across
the globe. Headquartered in Navsari, Gujarat, Beacon Diagnostics has grown into one of the most
trusted names in the industry, known for our quality, commitment, and technological excellence. For
over 33 years, we’ve been at the forefront of the IVD Manufacturer & Exporter in India, offering a
wide spectrum of reagents and instruments tailored for accurate medical testing. As a certified
company with ISO 9001:2015, ISO 13485:2016, and ZED Gold credentials, we ensure every product meets
international standards of performance and Regulatory compliances.
Our product line includes advanced systems like Top [biochemistry analyzers][19], [ Hematology
Analyzers][20], [ electrolyte analyzers][21], [ urine analyzers][22], which are designed to support
clinical labs with efficiency and precision, and there by supporting better patient outcomes for
healthier society. As a forward-thinking IVD manufacturer in India, Beacon’s reach spans across 90+
countries, powered by strong global collaborations. Back home, our presence is equally strong—with
135+ field experts, 100+ service engineers, and a distribution network of 400+ partners catering to
private, public, and semi-government healthcare sectors. At the core of Beacon India is a team
driven by innovation and integrity. From our expertise in [ Beacon Reagents][23] to our reputation
as a dependable IVD Products manufacturer, we remain committed to empowering laboratories with tools
that are accurate, affordable, and accessible. Together, as the Beacon company, we continue to
illuminate the path forward in diagnostics—building trust, advancing technology, and improving
lives.

# Beacon Diagnostics - IVD Manufacturer & Exporter from India

At Beacon Diagnostics Pvt. Ltd., our journey began in 1990 with a clear mission — to deliver
reliable and innovative diagnostic solutions that elevate healthcare standards in India and across
the globe. Headquartered in Navsari, Gujarat, Beacon Diagnostics has grown into one of the most
trusted names in the industry, known for our quality, commitment, and technological excellence. For
over 33 years, we’ve been at the forefront of the IVD Manufacturer & Exporter in India, offering a
wide spectrum of reagents and instruments tailored for accurate medical testing. As a certified
company with ISO 9001:2015, ISO 13485:2016, and ZED Gold credentials, we ensure every product meets
international standards of performance and Regulatory compliances.
Our product line includes advanced systems like Top [biochemistry analyzers][19], [ Hematology
Analyzers][20], [ electrolyte analyzers][21], [ urine analyzers][22], which are designed to support
clinical labs with efficiency and precision, and there by supporting better patient outcomes for
healthier society. As a forward-thinking IVD manufacturer in India, Beacon’s reach spans across 90+
countries, powered by strong global collaborations. Back home, our presence is equally strong—with
135+ field experts, 100+ service engineers, and a distribution network of 400+ partners catering to
private, public, and semi-government healthcare sectors. At the core of Beacon India is a team
driven by innovation and integrity. From our expertise in [ Beacon Reagents][23] to our reputation
as a dependable IVD Products manufacturer, we remain committed to empowering laboratories with tools
that are accurate, affordable, and accessible. Together, as the Beacon company, we continue to
illuminate the path forward in diagnostics—building trust, advancing technology, and improving
lives.

# Who we are?

The Clinical Development Services Agency (CDSA) functions as an academic research unit established
to facilitate the development of new drugs, treatment regimes, and affordable healthcare products.
It aims to develop an ecosystem that supports the design, planning, and delivery of large-scale
multi-centre clinical trials/cohort studies across a varied portfolio of clinical specialties. The
unit works with public sector institutions and small and medium enterprises (SMEs) to translate
innovative technologies and new drugs into medical products.

CDSA was launched on 28 September 2009 as an extramural unit of Translational Health Science and
Technology Institute (THSTI) by the Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Ministry of Science and
Technology.

## [What We Provide][59]

GCCPL Pharmaceuticals is a trusted name among pharmaceutical drug manufacturers in India. We
specialize in the production and supply of high-quality active pharma ingredients (API),
pharmaceutical intermediates, finished dosage forms, and innovative nutraceuticals. With robust
pharmaceutical manufacturing capabilities, we cater to domestic and international markets, offering
end-to-end solutions, from manufacturing to exporting and distribution, ensuring global compliance
and reliability.

### Products

G.C Chemie Pharmie, is an innovative Indian pharmaceutical, nutraceutical & functional foods company
with a global presence.

### Services

Market Research and Development, Concept Selling, Reach & Penetration, Right Infrastructure, Market
Intelligence.

### Manufacturing Plants

manufacturing of API, Excipients and Dairy ingredients

## [Our Story][60]

G.C Chemie Pharmie, is an innovative Indian Pharmaceutical, Health Supplements & Functional Foods
company with a global presence.

Founded in the year 1981 by Gautam Shah, GCCPL aims to be one the leading pharma players in the
Indian markets. We partner with associates & clients alike to deliver customized solutions that
resolve their significant issues and create lasting competitive advantage.

GCCPL is proud to serve the pharmaceutical and food supplement industry for the past 43 years and
aim to continue doing so for years to come.

[ READ MORE ][61]

## Our Manufacturing Facilities

GCCPL operates state-of-the-art facilities strategically located across India. Our two facilities
are state of the art, regulation compliant plants. Our facility in Vapi, Gujarat, manufactures API,
Minerals & Peptide while the second facility specializes in Excipients. Each facility adheres to
WHO-GMP and other international regulatory standards. With advanced automation, strict quality
controls, and scalable production lines, we ensure efficiency in producing APIs, intermediates, and
finished dosage forms as leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers known for superior pharmaceutical
manufacturing practices.

[ VIEW DETAILS ][62]

### Novomix

Excipients are offered via our manufacturing plant, Novo Excipients Pvt Ltd. Readymix film coating
material followed by HPMC, PVP series under the brand Novo integrated to Novomix from Indian
manufacturing facilities and Novodone/Novocoat from China.

### Eagle Chemical Works

Eagle Chemical Works is an API, Minerals & Peptide manufacturing company which was established in
1978 at Vapi, Gujarat. The Company is now poised to grow further by expanding its facilities by
creating plants which would be approved by USFDA and EU authorities.

## Our Products

GCCPL offers a diverse portfolio of pharmaceutical and healthcare products designed to meet global
standards. Our range includes Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and Pharmaceutical
Intermediates manufactured under strict quality controls. We provide Health Supplements and
Functional Foods to support wellness and preventive care. Our advanced Biologics and Vaccines
address evolving medical needs and public health priorities. The Finished Dosage Forms segment
features tablets, capsules, and injectables for reliable patient outcomes. Additionally, our Branded
Formulations are developed for therapeutic effectiveness and affordability in specific markets. With
innovation and trust, GCCPL is your reliable partner in pharmaceutical excellence.

## About Us

# India’s Leading Medical Equipments Manufacturers & Exporters

GST Corporation Limited (**GSTC**) is one of India’s leading Medical Equipments Manufacturers &
Exporters, with more than six decades of dedication in providing trusted & reliable medical
solutions worldwide since 1959. Based in New Delhi, we are into surgical equipments, rehabilitation
aids, orthopedic implants, and** FDA-approved medical disposables **with the highest international
standard.

 

## **Global Reach. Certified Quality.**

With the support of FDA, CE, EAR,  ISO 9001:2015, and ISO 13485:2016 certifications,GSTC has
established a good reputation for high quality, best manufacturing, and conformance to regulations.
Hospitals, clinics, non-governmental organizations, and tender authorities in over 65 nations across
the globe, including the USA, Canada, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Southeast Asia, and Latin
America, accept our products in the majority of cases. We are among the leading exporters of medical
devices from India.

 

## **Trusted by Governments, NGOs & Global Health Missions**

GSTC has developed long-term alliances with over 400 customers, including **UNICEF, UNDP, the World
Bank, **and **government health ministries** and international tendering authorities of different
countries. We stand as one of** India’s leading medical equipments manufacturers & exporters ** that
have international certifications and are renowned for our dependability in **OEM cooperation **with
top international companies.

 

### **What We Offer**
* **Top-quality surgical instruments from India**
* **The best orthopedic implants available for export**
* **FDA certified medical disposables in bulk**
* **Customizable OEM solutions for global healthcare projects**
* **Specialized products for gynecology, [anesthesia][31], emergency care, ICU, and diagnostics**

Whether you’re a private healthcare provider, institutional buyer, or sourcing agency, GSTC ensures
**on-time delivery, consistent quality, and global compliance** every step of the way.

### ** Why Choose GSTC?**
* **60+ years of manufacturing excellence**
* **Exporting to 65+ countries and expanding**
* **Certified by CE, FDA, ISO 13485**
* **Comprehensive product range across key medical categories**
* **Dedicated OEM/private labeling for global brands**
* **Proven track record with humanitarian and development agencies**
* As the medical equipments manufacturers & exporters, GSTC continues to innovate, expand, and raise
  the bar for affordable, certified medical devices worldwide.

### Manufacturing Excellence

[ READ MORE ][33]

## Who We Are 

Precision meets innovation in the design, manufacturing, and supply of most vital medical devices.
With a state-of-the-art, EN ISO 13485-certified facility, we ensure unparalleled quality through
integrated production and testing processes. Empowering healthcare professionals with trusted
solutions, we are dedicated to advancing patient care and shaping a healthier future, globally.

##### What we do

Driven by an obsession with perfection, we manufacture internationally benchmarked medical devices
and solutions by constantly researching, discovering, inventing and refining what we do.

##### Purpose

To provide best-in-class medical devices that meet exacting international standards, driving
innovation and enhancing patient care with unparalleled quality and performance.

##### Impact

We foster global trust through unwavering reliability, stringent quality standards, and strong
partnerships, transforming the medical landscape with devices that set new benchmarks for excellence
and precision.

## Contract Manufacturing

Advancing the medical industry with innovative, reliable, and safe solutions, Kamal Medtech
specializes in interventional cardiology and dental implantology. As a premier Indian manufacturer,
our 50,000 sq. ft. state-of-the-art facility adheres to the highest global standards, ensuring
precision, quality and compliance.
[ READ MORE ][34]

## OEM Services

Specializing in innovative OEM services, Kamal Medtech delivers bespoke solutions tailored to meet
the diverse needs of the medical device industry. Our state-of-the-art in-house manufacturing
capabilities, including thorough microbiology, physico-chemical, and drug-related testing, guarantee
the highest standards of quality, precision, and reliability across all products.
[ READ MORE ][35]

## Kamal Medtech @Work

Obsessed with detail our innovation stems from rigorous R&D and multi-tier quality checks, ensuring
every product meets exacting global benchmarks. With strictly monitored manufacturing environments,
we deliver excellence from raw materials to final output, offering only the finest solutions to the
world.
[ READ MORE ][36]

Employing the latest advancements in medical technology to ensure unparalleled device precision.

##### Advanced Research Labs

Equipped with state-of-the-art tools for innovative testing and product development.

##### Medical-Grade Sterile Environments

Controlled, sterilized rooms ensuring safety and compliance for medical-grade production.

##### Next-Generation Manufacturing Facility

An ultramodern facility designed for streamlined, efficient, and scalable production processes.

##### Dedicated R&D Excellence

A specialized center driving innovation and advancement in medical device development.

##### Expert-Led Teams

Industry specialists ensuring precision, quality, and innovation in every product.

##### Pioneering Indigenous Products

Proudly developing products crafted within the region, meeting global standards of excellence.

##### Uncompromising Quality

High-quality medical devices built to meet and exceed healthcare industry expectations.

*‘Inspired by Life, Driven by Science’*

Kekule is a leading Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API) and Intermediates manufacturer, known
for its strong brand equity and long standing customer relationships. Development of innovative
processes with backward integration for synthesis of wide range of products is at the core of what
we do. With Three units located in Hyderabad, Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam, we aim to position
ourselves as a trusted partner for all your API and Intermediate requirements. High quality,
cost-competitive products with a short development time is our USP.

## With over 47+ Years of Industry knowledge & experience

### Who We Are

Founded in 1978 by entrepreneur Late Mr. Pratap Mehta, who brought over 25 years of industry
experience, Kilitch seized early opportunities with its deep industry knowledge. At Kilitch Drugs
(India) Ltd, we are committed to advancing global health through the manufacturing and supply of
high-quality pharmaceutical formulations. With a strong focus on excellence, innovation, and
accessibility, we proudly serve healthcare professionals and patients around the world.

## About Us

### Who We Are

Lattice MedTech, backed by **[OrbiMed][18]** (a $17Bn global healthcare fund), is building India’s
next-generation MedTech platform. Our mission is to unify and modernize the fragmented medical
device distribution landscape, enabling global brands and Indian manufacturers to scale efficiently.

[ Read More][19]

## Our Services

[ ]

### [Distribution of Medical Devices ][20]

We offer a wide range of medical devices across critical specialties, including cardiology,
orthopedics, general surgery, critical care, and IVD. As a prominent cardiology distributor, we
enhance our offerings. With our pan-India fulfillment ability through our distribution partners,
including our role as a surgical distributor in India and a trusted Medtech distributor in India, we
can enable unparalleled reach of medical devices for our clients.

[ Read More][21]
[ ]

### [ Strategic Manufacturing][22]

With our deep capabilities in the MedTech manufacturing ecosystem in India, we aspire to be the
first choice as a Medtech distributor in India and strategic manufacturing partner for global
companies. Our goal is to support their mission as a leading cardiology distributor and surgical
distributor in India, providing high-quality, cost-effective solutions for patients across the world

[ Read More][23]
[ ]

### [Full Service Distribution Partnerships][24]

We leverage best-in-class teams and cutting-edge technology as a leading Medtech distributor in
India to provide fast, reliable, compliant, and cost-effective market expansion services. Our
expertise as a cardiology distributor and surgical distributor in India ensures that global medical
device companies can successfully enter and thrive in the Indian market

[ Read More][25]

## Our Purpose
* Transforming India’s fragmented MedTech distribution into a unified, specialty-driven platform.
* Trusted partner for global brands and Indian manufacturers.
* Enabling faster, compliant, and profitable access to India’s $50B+ healthcare market.
* Expertise in sales, regulatory affairs, and logistics with a pan-India distribution network.
* Driving equitable access to advanced healthcare across hospitals, clinics, and tier-2/3 cities.

##### About Lotus

## A medical device range at par with the best in the world

Lotus, a brand of TI Medical, with a 17-year legacy, is a leading name in the Medical Device
Industry, operating from a state-of-the-art 60,000 square feet facility in Dehradun, India,
featuring Class 10,000 Clean Rooms and a specialized 100% EtO Sterilizer. We take immense pride in
delivering top-notch Sterile Medical Devices with an unwavering commitment to quality. Our product
range includes Absorbable & Non-Absorbable Sutures, Meshes, Haemostats, Endo & Energy Devices,
catering to various medical specialties across 25,000+ hospitals in 60+ countries.

Lotus has earned recognition in the industry, winning the Frost & Sullivan Best Consumables Company
of the Year in 2013 and being named the Economic Times Best Healthcare Brand in 2023, 2024 & 2025.
We are dedicated to innovation, excellence, and a global vision that propels us forward in the
healthcare industry. We embrace the dynamism of surgical innovation. Join us to discover the
intricate world of medical devices, where precision, innovation, and care come together to redefine
surgical excellence. Welcome to the future of medical technology at Lotus.

## Our Range of Products

Complete range of Absorbable & Non-Absorbable, Braided & Monofilament sutures catering to every
specialty, including Cardio-Vascular and Plastic surgery

## our story

# A Healthcare Channel Partner Company Founded in the year 2000

Medikon India Pvt Ltd was founded in the year 2000 with an ambitious goal – to create a
global **Healthcare Channel Partner**** & marketing company**, which bridges the gap between the
ideal solution that should be provided for the Patient and the actual solution that was being
provided by Public and Institutional hospitals.


Our founders, Anuj and Rajat Bhatiani, have drawn on decades of experience from their father Shri
Manjeet Bhatiani, who had worked in institutional healthcare business for over three decades with
M/s. Abbott (formerly known as M/s.Sarabhai Chemical).

At Medikon, we are committed to provide the best quality of services & customised solutions,
ensuring that immediate challenges and needs of healthcare companies are meet.

At Medikon, we understand the importance of providing high-quality products to hospitals in India
for ensuring the best patient care. This is why, we conducted extensive research on 140+
manufacturing companies before selecting the right companies for supply of various products.

Today, Medikon India Pvt Ltd stands as leader in the distribution of healthcare products & services
in Public Health Market Institutional Segment. Our commitment to quality and service has helped us
become a trusted name in healthcare sector.

Founded in 2000, by the dynamic brothers Anuj and Rajat Bhatiani, Medikon India Pvt Ltd is a
dedicated team of highly trained professionals.

### Here Is A Little ** About Us**

Medorah Meditek Pvt Ltd is an ISO 13485 Certified Indian medical device manufacturing company
headquartered in Delhi. We have been operating in India since 2016, and our primary focus is to
supply the highest quality Gastroenterology, Pulmonology, and Interventional Radiology equipment and
accessories.

We aim to bring significant technological advancements to the medical device industry and improve
global healthcare standards.
Keeping the requirements of both regulatory authorities and our customers in mind, we are leading
the industry in the design, development, manufacturing, and sales of innovative medical devices
critical to gastroenterology, pulmonology, and interventional radiology.

Our purpose is to make healthcare affordable and accessible for everyone. Our Mission guides and
reminds us that we are helping India by providing quality healthcare to millions of people who
otherwise would not be able to afford it.

[Learn More][78]

##### Our Quality Policy

At Medorah Meditek Pvt. Ltd., our Quality Policy summarises the essential elements of our commitment
to excellence and includes:

• Fostering a quality mind-set to develop, manufacture and provide products with zero defects and
optimum performance that are trusted and preferred by Healthcare Professionals and deliver on our
commitment to improve the lives of the ailing population,
• Complying with relevant laws and regulations as well as internal requirements,
• Continual improvement of the Quality Management System to guarantee product safety, avoid failures
and eliminate defects by evaluating quality objectives and results, and
• Promoting the Quality Management System and ensuring implementation amongst all employees and
third parties through standards, education, training, coaching, supervision and effective
communication.

### Here Is A Little ** About Us**

Medorah Meditek Pvt Ltd is an ISO 13485 Certified Indian medical device manufacturing company
headquartered in Delhi. We have been operating in India since 2016, and our primary focus is to
supply the highest quality Gastroenterology, Pulmonology, and Interventional Radiology equipment and
accessories.

We aim to bring significant technological advancements to the medical device industry and improve
global healthcare standards.
Keeping the requirements of both regulatory authorities and our customers in mind, we are leading
the industry in the design, development, manufacturing, and sales of innovative medical devices
critical to gastroenterology, pulmonology, and interventional radiology.

Our purpose is to make healthcare affordable and accessible for everyone. Our Mission guides and
reminds us that we are helping India by providing quality healthcare to millions of people who
otherwise would not be able to afford it.

[Learn More][78]

##### Our Quality Policy

At Medorah Meditek Pvt. Ltd., our Quality Policy summarises the essential elements of our commitment
to excellence and includes:

• Fostering a quality mind-set to develop, manufacture and provide products with zero defects and
optimum performance that are trusted and preferred by Healthcare Professionals and deliver on our
commitment to improve the lives of the ailing population,
• Complying with relevant laws and regulations as well as internal requirements,
• Continual improvement of the Quality Management System to guarantee product safety, avoid failures
and eliminate defects by evaluating quality objectives and results, and
• Promoting the Quality Management System and ensuring implementation amongst all employees and
third parties through standards, education, training, coaching, supervision and effective
communication.

### Why **Medorah Meditek ?**

Medorah Meditek helps you transform your patients' lives with remarkable innovations and
technologies. Our equipment improves healthcare standards by providing more straightforward and
efficient solutions for your requirements.
* We thoroughly research the market to understand your current needs and requirements.
* We are an ethically run business that works to make healthcare accessible and affordable
  worldwide.
* Under the "Make in India" platform, we aim to significantly reduce import dependency in the Indian
  scenario, thereby reducing healthcare costs and promoting local innovation.
* By collaborating with stakeholders to solve their complex problems, we design and develop
  solutions that matter most to healthcare providers. We are committed to using our technologies,
  capabilities, and expertise to seek innovations to address your concerns and deliver the most
  effective solutions possible.

[Have a Look At Our Products.][79]

### Products To Make ** Your Patient Care Easier. **

We are raising the standards for manufacturing medical devices in India under the Make in India
campaign. We strive to deliver technological innovations and the highest expertise in our products
and services. Frugal and highest quality innovation is a significant strength that Medorah Meditek
offers to the market.

# **Welcome to Reefer Express**

Reefer Express is a leading cold chain logistics solution company that offers integrated storage and
logistics solutions for temperature-controlled supply chains. We have best-in-class technology with
vehicle tracking, GPS services as well professional experience in the field of supply chain
management to ensure the safe delivery of products from farms all over India into cities where
they’re needed most!

Our business objective is to provide our customers with the best possible experience by offering an
efficient solution, competitive prices, and outstanding service. Whether you are entering a new
market, need a leaner supply chain, predictable costs, operational transparency, or a storage
solution – we have got you covered.

[reefer express]

## OUR SERVICES

[Refrigerated logistics]

###### Cold Chain Solutions

Reefer Express is a specialized provider of cold chain solutions for the pharmaceutical industry. We
offer a complete range of services, from product storage and transportation to distribution and
delivery.

[Learn More][71]

[logistic]

###### Temperature Controlled Logistics

We offer a temperature-controlled logistics service that helps to ensure your perishables remain
fresh and safe during transport. We utilize state-of-the-art temperature-controlled trailers and
containers to maintain the integrity of your products, whether they are sensitive to heat or cold.

[Learn More][72]

[Temperature Controlled Logistics]

###### Packaging & Distribution

Cold chain packaging for the pharmaceutical and biotech industries. We offer a complete portfolio of
cold chain packaging products and services that meet the most stringent industry regulation.

[Learn More][73]

[Healthcare logistics]

###### Healthcare Logistics Solutions

Reefer Express provides healthcare logistics services that ensure the safe and timely transport of
temperature-sensitive medical supplies and equipment.

[Learn More][74]

[cell and gene therapy logistics]

###### Cell and Gene Supply Chain

As the cell and gene therapy industry continues to grow, an efficient and reliable **cell and gene
supply chain** is essential to ensuring that these life-saving treatments can reach patients in
need.

[Learn More][75]

[Pharma Supply Chain logistics]

###### Pharma Supply Chain Solution

Reefer Express is a pharma supply chain solution specializing in the transport of
temperature-sensitive pharmaceuticals and biologics.

[Learn More][76]
[READ MORE][77]

## best Services & Products

## About Us

###### **About SPM Medicare**

**SPM MEDICARE PVT. LTD**. has set-up a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in the National
Capital Region (NCR) of India for manufacturing Disposable Medical Devices and Surgical Products.
Since the Company’s inception in 2015, SPM Medicare has emerged as one of the fastest growing
companies in India in the medical sector, and the Company has won laurels for its commitment to
Quality and Service in manufacturing and exporting finest products at competitive prices. This
company is also SEDEX approved ensuring social compliance & responsibilities.

The Company has installed top-of-the-line automatic machines in our facility with a quest to achieve
optimized manufacturing processes and to achieve highly safe and quality products. The Company
manufactures all products in side Clean Room Areas, and we have in-house ETO Sterilizer and
dedicated Quality Lab equipped to meet national and international regulatory requirements. In
addition to this, ease in the availability of raw material, experienced and dedicated team, and
backing from leading financial institutions helps us to operate smoothly and reliably. The Company
also values the hygiene and safety of our workers and ensures that they wear recommended safety gear
during production.

The Company maintains and follows the Quality Management System as per ISO 13485 certified by ITC
(Czech Republic). Further our products have also received CE certification from TUV (Germany) and
USFDA approved for various products. With above Certifications in place from the most stringent
quality authorities, the Company has been able to Market and place our products PAN-India as well as
in more than 30 countries around the world.

###### **About SPM Eurocare**

The European medical device market demands local presence, regulatory alignment, and responsive
partnerships. SPM EuroCare was established to bridge the gap between world-class manufacturing and
European healthcare needs.

## Welcome to

AiMeD is an Umbrella Association of Indian Manufacturers of Medical Devices covering all types of
Medical Devices including Consumables, Disposables, Equipments, Instruments, Electronics,
Diagnostics and Implants.  With a Primary Membership of over 300 Manufacturers and additionally of
over 200 Associate Members representing the interest of over 1200 Manufacturers of Medical Devices 
to address the manufacturer’s problems.

The aim behind forming AiMeD is  allow the Indian Government to access a single point of contact and
provide various services to the manufacturers like Advocacy on policy issues, Information services,
Regulations for Medical Devices, Education and Training, services, Testing Assistance and guidance
for Quality Certification (ISO, CE, GMP), Lobbying for funding for R&D from the Government,
encourage innovations from member units, Improve clinician and patient access to the modern,
innovative and reliable Medical Device technologies through organizing and supporting Meeting,
Seminars, Symposia, Exhibitions and Demonstrations and also, to promote global harmonization and
respect for the  Indian Device Industry.

## [What We Provide][59]

GCCPL Pharmaceuticals is a trusted name among pharmaceutical drug manufacturers in India. We
specialize in the production and supply of high-quality active pharma ingredients (API),
pharmaceutical intermediates, finished dosage forms, and innovative nutraceuticals. With robust
pharmaceutical manufacturing capabilities, we cater to domestic and international markets, offering
end-to-end solutions, from manufacturing to exporting and distribution, ensuring global compliance
and reliability.

G.C Chemie Pharmie, is an innovative Indian pharmaceutical, nutraceutical & functional foods company
with a global presence.

## Who We Are 

Precision meets innovation in the design, manufacturing, and supply of most vital medical devices.
With a state-of-the-art, EN ISO 13485-certified facility, we ensure unparalleled quality through
integrated production and testing processes. Empowering healthcare professionals with trusted
solutions, we are dedicated to advancing patient care and shaping a healthier future, globally.

##### What we do

Driven by an obsession with perfection, we manufacture internationally benchmarked medical devices
and solutions by constantly researching, discovering, inventing and refining what we do.

##### Purpose

To provide best-in-class medical devices that meet exacting international standards, driving
innovation and enhancing patient care with unparalleled quality and performance.

##### Impact

We foster global trust through unwavering reliability, stringent quality standards, and strong
partnerships, transforming the medical landscape with devices that set new benchmarks for excellence
and precision.

## Contract Manufacturing

Advancing the medical industry with innovative, reliable, and safe solutions, Kamal Medtech
specializes in interventional cardiology and dental implantology. As a premier Indian manufacturer,
our 50,000 sq. ft. state-of-the-art facility adheres to the highest global standards, ensuring
precision, quality and compliance.
[ READ MORE ][34]

## OEM Services

Specializing in innovative OEM services, Kamal Medtech delivers bespoke solutions tailored to meet
the diverse needs of the medical device industry. Our state-of-the-art in-house manufacturing
capabilities, including thorough microbiology, physico-chemical, and drug-related testing, guarantee
the highest standards of quality, precision, and reliability across all products.
[ READ MORE ][35]

## Kamal Medtech @Work

Obsessed with detail our innovation stems from rigorous R&D and multi-tier quality checks, ensuring
every product meets exacting global benchmarks. With strictly monitored manufacturing environments,
we deliver excellence from raw materials to final output, offering only the finest solutions to the
world.

## With over 47+ Years of Industry knowledge & experience

### Who We Are

Founded in 1978 by entrepreneur Late Mr. Pratap Mehta, who brought over 25 years of industry
experience, Kilitch seized early opportunities with its deep industry knowledge. At Kilitch Drugs
(India) Ltd, we are committed to advancing global health through the manufacturing and supply of
high-quality pharmaceutical formulations. With a strong focus on excellence, innovation, and
accessibility, we proudly serve healthcare professionals and patients around the world.

## our story

# A Healthcare Channel Partner Company Founded in the year 2000

Medikon India Pvt Ltd was founded in the year 2000 with an ambitious goal – to create a
global **Healthcare Channel Partner**** & marketing company**, which bridges the gap between the
ideal solution that should be provided for the Patient and the actual solution that was being
provided by Public and Institutional hospitals.


Our founders, Anuj and Rajat Bhatiani, have drawn on decades of experience from their father Shri
Manjeet Bhatiani, who had worked in institutional healthcare business for over three decades with
M/s. Abbott (formerly known as M/s.Sarabhai Chemical).

At Medikon, we are committed to provide the best quality of services & customised solutions,
ensuring that immediate challenges and needs of healthcare companies are meet.

At Medikon, we understand the importance of providing high-quality products to hospitals in India
for ensuring the best patient care. This is why, we conducted extensive research on 140+
manufacturing companies before selecting the right companies for supply of various products.

Today, Medikon India Pvt Ltd stands as leader in the distribution of healthcare products & services
in Public Health Market Institutional Segment. Our commitment to quality and service has helped us
become a trusted name in healthcare sector.

Founded in 2000, by the dynamic brothers Anuj and Rajat Bhatiani, Medikon India Pvt Ltd is a
dedicated team of highly trained professionals.

# **Welcome to Reefer Express**

Reefer Express is a leading cold chain logistics solution company that offers integrated storage and
logistics solutions for temperature-controlled supply chains. We have best-in-class technology with
vehicle tracking, GPS services as well professional experience in the field of supply chain
management to ensure the safe delivery of products from farms all over India into cities where
they’re needed most!

Our business objective is to provide our customers with the best possible experience by offering an
efficient solution, competitive prices, and outstanding service. Whether you are entering a new
market, need a leaner supply chain, predictable costs, operational transparency, or a storage
solution – we have got you covered.

[reefer express]

## OUR SERVICES

[Refrigerated logistics]

###### Cold Chain Solutions

Reefer Express is a specialized provider of cold chain solutions for the pharmaceutical industry. We
offer a complete range of services, from product storage and transportation to distribution and
delivery.

[Learn More][71]

[logistic]

###### Temperature Controlled Logistics

We offer a temperature-controlled logistics service that helps to ensure your perishables remain
fresh and safe during transport. We utilize state-of-the-art temperature-controlled trailers and
containers to maintain the integrity of your products, whether they are sensitive to heat or cold.

[Learn More][72]

[Temperature Controlled Logistics]

###### Packaging & Distribution

Cold chain packaging for the pharmaceutical and biotech industries. We offer a complete portfolio of
cold chain packaging products and services that meet the most stringent industry regulation.

[Learn More][73]

[Healthcare logistics]

###### Healthcare Logistics Solutions

Reefer Express provides healthcare logistics services that ensure the safe and timely transport of
temperature-sensitive medical supplies and equipment.

[Learn More][74]

[cell and gene therapy logistics]

###### Cell and Gene Supply Chain

As the cell and gene therapy industry continues to grow, an efficient and reliable **cell and gene
supply chain** is essential to ensuring that these life-saving treatments can reach patients in
need.

[Learn More][75]

[Pharma Supply Chain logistics]

###### Pharma Supply Chain Solution

Reefer Express is a pharma supply chain solution specializing in the transport of
temperature-sensitive pharmaceuticals and biologics.

[Learn More][76]

# **Welcome to Reefer Express**

Reefer Express is a leading cold chain logistics solution company that offers integrated storage and
logistics solutions for temperature-controlled supply chains. We have best-in-class technology with
vehicle tracking, GPS services as well professional experience in the field of supply chain
management to ensure the safe delivery of products from farms all over India into cities where
they’re needed most!

Our business objective is to provide our customers with the best possible experience by offering an
efficient solution, competitive prices, and outstanding service. Whether you are entering a new
market, need a leaner supply chain, predictable costs, operational transparency, or a storage
solution – we have got you covered.

[reefer express]

## OUR SERVICES

[Refrigerated logistics]

###### Cold Chain Solutions

Reefer Express is a specialized provider of cold chain solutions for the pharmaceutical industry. We
offer a complete range of services, from product storage and transportation to distribution and
delivery.

[Learn More][71]

[logistic]

###### Temperature Controlled Logistics

We offer a temperature-controlled logistics service that helps to ensure your perishables remain
fresh and safe during transport. We utilize state-of-the-art temperature-controlled trailers and
containers to maintain the integrity of your products, whether they are sensitive to heat or cold.

[Learn More][72]

[Temperature Controlled Logistics]

###### Packaging & Distribution

Cold chain packaging for the pharmaceutical and biotech industries. We offer a complete portfolio of
cold chain packaging products and services that meet the most stringent industry regulation.

[Learn More][73]

[Healthcare logistics]

###### Healthcare Logistics Solutions

Reefer Express provides healthcare logistics services that ensure the safe and timely transport of
temperature-sensitive medical supplies and equipment.

[Learn More][74]

[cell and gene therapy logistics]

###### Cell and Gene Supply Chain

As the cell and gene therapy industry continues to grow, an efficient and reliable **cell and gene
supply chain** is essential to ensuring that these life-saving treatments can reach patients in
need.

[Learn More][75]

[Pharma Supply Chain logistics]

###### Pharma Supply Chain Solution

Reefer Express is a pharma supply chain solution specializing in the transport of
temperature-sensitive pharmaceuticals and biologics.

[Learn More][76]

##### Flexible Storage Options

With access to the right pharmaceutical storage, Reefer Express is diligent to meet the specific
needs of your business. Whether you need short-term or long-term storage, we have a solution that
will work for you.

##### Temperature-controlled Environment

Our facility is equipped with the latest temperature-control features to ensure that your products
are stored in a safe and consistent environment. We have a free advanced data logger for each
storage unit to track the temperature and humidity levels in real-time.

##### 24/7 Monitoring & Security

Reefer Express offers you a complete solution for the storage of your pharmaceutical products. Our
facility is equipped with the latest security and temperature-control features to ensure the safety
of your products 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

##### Skilled WorkForce

We have a skilled workforce that is dedicated to providing you with the best possible service. We go
all the way to ensure that your refrigerated shipment is stored and delivered timely and efficiently
while maintaining product quality.
